concerns.text: The plan relies on a *synthetic surrogate* dataset (deterministic generation of 50 raster plots) instead of the required real subset of 50 failed figure generations from the CrafterBench dataset. FR‑001 explicitly mandates downloading and curating a static subset of *actual* CrafterBench failures; using synthetic data does not satisfy the functional requirement and may invalidate the cognitive‑load comparison.

The research document states that CrafterBench has “no verified source” and therefore falls back to synthetic data. This violates Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) which requires every external citation to be verified. A missing or unverified citation for the CrafterBench dataset means the dataset claim cannot be trusted.
